primaryTextChecks.text: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.

contextChecks.before: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
contextChecks.after: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
